mechanism: Loperamide may increase progesterone levels through hepatic metabolism inhibition (both are CYP3A4 substrates), and progesterone can potentiate loperamide's CNS depressant effects and constipatory actions.
action: Monitor for excessive CNS depression and severe constipation; consider alternative antidiarrheal agents or dose adjustment of loperamide if used concurrently with progesterone.
